root.label: Fake RNC convention website redirects to DOJ Epstein files

events.label: Fake RNC convention website redirects to DOJ Epstein files

slots.name: convention date
slots.sentence: A fake website claiming to be associated with the Republican National Committee’s (RNC) midterm convention, taking place Sept. 9-10 in Dallas, redirects to the Justice Department’s homepage for the Epstein files.

slots.name: official website
slots.sentence: The official website for the convention is gopconvention.com.

slots.name: redirect status
slots.sentence: The unofficial site, gopdallas2026.com, still redirects to the Epstein files database run by the Justice Department as of Sept. 7.
